"API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- graphify: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).

205			MemoFilter:        &memoFilter,

210		allRelations := mergeMemoRelations(outgoingRelations, incomingRelations)
211	
212		// Collect all memo IDs referenced in relations that we need to resolve.
213		neededIDs := make(map[int32]bool)
214		for _, r := range allRelations {
215			neededIDs[r.MemoID] = true
216			neededIDs[r.RelatedMemoID] = true
217		}
218	
219		// Build ID→UID map from the memos we already have.
220		memoIDToUID := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
221		memoIDToSnippet := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
222		for _, m := range memos {
223			memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
224			if includeSnippets {
225				snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
226				if err != nil {
227					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo content snippet")
228				}
229				memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
230			}
231			delete(neededIDs, m.ID)
232		}
233	
234		// Batch fetch any additional memos referenced by relations that we don't already have.
235		if len(neededIDs) > 0 {
236			extraIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(neededIDs))
237			for id := range neededIDs {
238				extraIDs = append(extraIDs, id)
239			}
240			extraFind := &store.FindMemo{IDList: extraIDs, ExcludeContent: !includeSnippets}
241			extraMemos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, extraFind)
242			if err != nil {
243				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch fetch related memos")
244			}
245			for _, m := range extraMemos {
246				memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
247				if includeSnippets {
248					snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
249					if err != nil {
250						return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo content snippet")
251					}
252					memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
253				}
254			}
255		}
256	
257		// Build the result map: memo ID → its relations (both directions).
258		result := make(map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, len(memos))
259		for _, r := range allRelations {
260			memoUID, ok1 := memoIDToUID[r.MemoID]
261			relatedUID, ok2 := memoIDToUID[r.RelatedMemoID]
262			if !ok1 || !ok2 {
263				continue
264			}
265	
266			relation := &v1pb.MemoRelation{
267				Memo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
268					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memoUID),
269					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.MemoID],
270				},
271				RelatedMemo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
272					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedUID),
273					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.RelatedMemoID],
274				},
275				Type: convertMemoRelationTypeFromStore(r.Type),
276			}
277	
278			// Add to the memo that owns this relation (both directions).
279			if memoIDSet[r.MemoID] {
280				result[r.MemoID] = append(result[r.MemoID], relation)
281			}
282			if memoIDSet[r.RelatedMemoID] {
283				result[r.RelatedMemoID] = append(result[r.RelatedMemoID], relation)
284			}
285		}
286	
287		return result, nil
288	}

299	func mergeMemoRelations(groups ...[]*store.MemoRelation) []*store.MemoRelation {
300		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
301		merged := make([]*store.MemoRelation, 0)
302		for _, relations := range groups {
303			for _, relation := range relations {
304				key := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", relation.MemoID, relation.RelatedMemoID, relation.Type)
305				if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
306					continue
307				}
308				seen[key] = struct{}{}
309				merged = append(merged, relation)
310			}
311		}
312		return merged
313	}

11	func (*APIV1Service) parseMemoOrderBy(orderBy string, memoFind *store.FindMemo) error {
12		if strings.TrimSpace(orderBy) == "" {
13			return errors.New("empty order_by")
14		}
15	
16		// Split by comma to support multiple sort fields per AIP-132.
17		fields := strings.Split(orderBy, ",")
18	
19		// Track if we've seen pinned field.
20		hasPinned := false
21		hasExplicitTimeField := false
22	
23		for _, field := range fields {
24			parts := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(field))
25			if len(parts) == 0 {
26				continue
27			}
28	
29			fieldName := parts[0]
30			fieldDirection := "desc" // default per AIP-132 (we use desc as default for time fields)
31			if len(parts) > 1 {
32				fieldDirection = strings.ToLower(parts[1])
33				if fieldDirection != "asc" && fieldDirection != "desc" {
34					return errors.Errorf("invalid order direction: %s, must be 'asc' or 'desc'", parts[1])
35				}
36			}
37	
38			switch fieldName {
39			case "pinned":
40				hasPinned = true
41				memoFind.OrderByPinned = true
42				// Note: pinned is always DESC (true first) regardless of direction specified.
43			case "create_time", "name":
44				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
45				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
46					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
47				}
48				hasExplicitTimeField = true
49			case "update_time":
50				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
51				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
52					memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs = true
53					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
54				}
55				hasExplicitTimeField = true
56			default:
57				return errors.Errorf("unsupported order field: %s, supported fields are: pinned, create_time, update_time, name", fieldName)
58			}
59		}
60	
61		// If only pinned was specified, still need to set a default time ordering.
62		if hasPinned && !memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs && len(fields) == 1 {
63			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false // default to desc
64		}
65	
66		return nil
67	}

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91	
92		creator, err := ResolveUserByName(ctx, s.Store, memoComment.Creator)
93		if err != nil {
94			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo creator")
95		}
96		if creator == nil {
97			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo creator not found")
98		}
99		creatorID := creator.ID
100		if memoComment.Visibility != v1pb.Visibility_PRIVATE && creatorID != relatedMemo.CreatorID {
101			if _, err := s.createInboxWithEmailNotification(ctx, &store.Inbox{
102				SenderID:   creatorID,
103				ReceiverID: relatedMemo.CreatorID,
104				Status:     store.UNREAD,
105				Message: &storepb.InboxMessage{
106					Type: storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT,
107					Payload: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoComment{
108						MemoComment: &storepb.InboxMessage_MemoCommentPayload{
109							MemoId:        memo.ID,
110							RelatedMemoId: relatedMemo.ID,
111						},
112					},
113				},
114			}); err != nil {
115				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create inbox")
116			}
117		}
118	
119		if err := s.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook(ctx, memoComment, relatedMemo.CreatorID); err != nil {
120			slog.Warn("Failed to dispatch memo comment created webhook", slog.Any("err", err))
121		}
122	
123		s.dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort(ctx, memo, relatedMemo, "")
124	
125		// Broadcast live refresh event for the parent memo so subscribers see the new comment.
126		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(&SSEEvent{
127			Type:       SSEEventMemoCommentCreated,
128			Name:       request.Name,
129			Visibility: relatedMemo.Visibility,
130			CreatorID:  relatedMemo.CreatorID,
131		})
132	
133		return memoComment, nil
134	}

136	func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemoComments(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListMemoCommentsRequest) (*v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse, error) {

158			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
159		} else {
160			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
161		}
162		memoRelationComment := store.MemoRelationComment
163		var limit, offset int
164		if request.PageToken != "" {
165			var pageToken v1pb.PageToken
166			if err := unmarshalPageToken(request.PageToken, &pageToken); err != nil {
167				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid page token: %v", err)
168			}
169			limit = normalizePageSize(pageToken.Limit)
170			offset = max(int(pageToken.Offset), 0)
171		} else {
172			limit = normalizePageSize(request.PageSize)
173		}
174		limitPlusOne := limit + 1

176			RelatedMemoID: &memo.ID,

183			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memo relations")

190			if err != nil {
191				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get next page token, error: %v", err)

193		}

195		if len(memoRelations) == 0 {
196			response := &v1pb.ListMemoCommentsResponse{
197				Memos:         []*v1pb.Memo{},
198				NextPageToken: nextPageToken,
199			}
200			return response, nil
201		}
202	
203		memoRelationIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memoRelations))
204		for _, m := range memoRelations {
205			memoRelationIDs = append(memoRelationIDs, m.MemoID)
206		}

208		if err != nil {
209			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list memos")
210		}
211	
212		memoIDToNameMap := make(map[int32]string)
213		contentIDs := make([]string, 0, len(memos))
214		memoIDsForAttachments := make([]int32, 0, len(memos))
215	
216		for _, memo := range memos {

218			memoIDToNameMap[memo.ID] = memoName
219			contentIDs = append(contentIDs, memoName)

230		}

232		attachments, err := s.Store.ListAttachments(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{MemoIDList: memoIDsForAttachments})
233		if err != nil {
234			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list attachments")

237		for _, attachment := range attachments {
238			attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID] = append(attachmentMap[*attachment.MemoID], attachment)
239		}

241		// RELATIONS (batch load to avoid N+1)
242		relationMap, err := s.batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx, memos, false)
243		if err != nil {
244			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to batch load memo relations")
245		}
246		creatorIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(memos)+len(reactions))
247		for _, memo := range memos {
248			creatorIDs = append(creatorIDs, memo.CreatorID)

16		// Extract memo UID and check visibility.

23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
24		}
25		if memo == nil {
26			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
27		}
28	
29		// Check memo visibility.
30		if memo.Visibility != store.Public {
31			user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)

33				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")

35			if user == nil {
36				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")

54		if err != nil {
55			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to convert reactions")
56		}

60	func (s *APIV1Service) UpsertMemoReaction(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.UpsertMemoReactionRequest) (*v1pb.Reaction, error) {
61		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
62		if err != nil {
63			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get current user")
64		}
65		if user == nil {
66			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
67		}
68	
69		// Extract memo UID and check visibility before allowing reaction.
70		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Reaction.ContentId)
71		if err != nil {
72			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
73		}
74		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
75		if err != nil {
76			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo: %v", err)
77		}
78		if memo == nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
80		}
81	
82		// Check memo visibility.
83		if memo.Visibility == store.Private && memo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
84			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
85		}
86	
87		reaction, err := s.Store.UpsertReaction(ctx, &store.Reaction{
88			CreatorID:    user.ID,
89			ContentID:    request.Reaction.ContentId,
90			ReactionType: request.Reaction.ReactionType,
91		})
92		if err != nil {
93			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to upsert reaction")
94		}
95	
96		reactionMessage, err := s.convertReactionFromStore(ctx, reaction)
97		if err != nil {
98			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to convert reaction")
99		}
100	
101		// Broadcast live refresh event (reaction belongs to a memo).
102		var parentMemo *store.Memo
103		if memo.ParentUID != nil {
104			parentMemo, _ = s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
105		}
106		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(buildMemoReactionSSEEvent(SSEEventReactionUpserted, request.Reaction.ContentId, memo, parentMemo))
107	
108		return reactionMessage, nil
109	}

124

126		reaction, err := s.Store.GetReaction(ctx, &store.FindReaction{

129		if err != nil {
130			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get reaction")

133			// Return permission denied to avoid revealing if reaction exists.

136	
137		if reaction.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
138			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
139		}
140	
141		if err := s.Store.DeleteReaction(ctx, &store.DeleteReaction{
142			ID: reactionID,
143		}); err != nil {
144			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to delete reaction")
145		}

148		if err != nil {
149			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
150		}
151		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
152		if err != nil {
153			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
154		}

158		if memo != nil && memo.ParentUID != nil {
159			parentMemo, _ = s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: memo.ParentUID})
160		}
161		s.SSEHub.Broadcast(buildMemoReactionSSEEvent(SSEEventReactionDeleted, reaction.ContentID, memo, parentMemo))
162	
163		return &emptypb.Empty{}, nil
164	}

54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.
55	// It is safe for concurrent use.
56	type SSEHub struct {
57		mu      sync.RWMutex
58		clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}
59		closed  bool
60	}

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {
64		return &SSEHub{
65			clients: make(map[*SSEClient]struct{}),
66		}
67	}

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c
86	}
87	
88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)
94		}
95		h.mu.Unlock()
96	}
97	
98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.
99	func (h *SSEHub) Close() {
100		h.mu.Lock()
101		defer h.mu.Unlock()
102		if h.closed {
103			return
104		}
105		h.closed = true
106		for c := range h.clients {
107			delete(h.clients, c)
108			close(c.events)
109		}
110	}

112	// Broadcast sends an event to all connected clients.
113	// Slow clients that have a full buffer will have the event dropped
114	// to avoid blocking the broadcaster.
115	func (h *SSEHub) Broadcast(event *SSEEvent) {
116		data := event.JSON()
117		if len(data) == 0 {
118			return
119		}
120		h.mu.RLock()
121		defer h.mu.RUnlock()
122		for c := range h.clients {
123			if !c.canReceive(event) {
124				continue
125			}
126			select {
127			case c.events <- data:
128			default:
129				// Drop event for slow client to avoid blocking.
130			}
131		}
132	}

131	// serveAttachmentFile serves attachment binary content using native HTTP.
132	func (s *FileServerService) serveAttachmentFile(c *echo.Context) error {
133		ctx := c.Request().Context()
134		uid := c.Param("uid")
135		wantThumbnail := c.QueryParam("thumbnail") == "true"
136		wantMotion := c.QueryParam("motion") == "true"
137	
138		attachment, err := s.Store.GetAttachment(ctx, &store.FindAttachment{
139			UID:     &uid,
140			GetBlob: true,
141		})
142		if err != nil {
143			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusInternalServerError, "failed to get attachment").Wrap(err)
144		}
145		if attachment == nil {
146			return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusNotFound, "attachment not found")
147		}
148	
149		if err := s.checkAttachmentPermission(ctx, c, attachment); err != nil {
150			return err
151		}
152	
153		if wantMotion {
154			return s.serveMotionClip(c, attachment)
155		}
156	
157		contentType := s.sanitizeContentType(attachment.Type)
158	
159		// Stream video/audio to avoid loading entire file into memory.
160		if isMediaType(attachment.Type) {
161			return s.serveMediaStream(c, attachment, contentType)
162		}
163	
164		return s.serveStaticFile(c, attachment, contentType, wantThumbnail)
165	}

179				return echo.NewHTTPError(http.StatusUnauthorized, "unauthorized access")

20	func (s *APIV1Service) ListUserNotifications(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.ListUserNotificationsRequest) (*v1pb.ListUserNotificationsResponse, error) {

25		userID := user.ID

27		// Verify the requesting user has permission to view these notifications

31		}
32		if currentUser == nil {
33			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
34		}
35		if currentUser.ID != userID {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
37		}
38	
39		// Fetch inbox items from storage.
40		inboxes, err := s.Store.ListInboxes(ctx, &store.FindInbox{
41			ReceiverID: &userID,
42		})
43		if err != nil {
44			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list inboxes: %v", err)
45		}
46	
47		// Convert storage layer inboxes to API notifications.
48		userIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(inboxes)*2)
49		for _, inbox := range inboxes {
50			userIDs = append(userIDs, inbox.ReceiverID, inbox.SenderID)
51		}
52		usersByID, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, userIDs)

54			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list notification users: %v", err)

58			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to list notification memos: %v", err)
59		}
60	
61		notifications := []*v1pb.UserNotification{}
62		for _, inbox := range inboxes {
63			notification, err := s.convertInboxToUserNotificationWithUsersAndMemos(inbox, currentUser, usersByID, memosByID)
64			if err != nil {
65				if status.Code(err) == codes.NotFound {
66					slog.Warn("Skipping notification with missing user",
67						slog.Int64("notification_id", int64(inbox.ID)),
68						slog.Int64("receiver_id", int64(inbox.ReceiverID)),
69						slog.Int64("sender_id", int64(inbox.SenderID)),
70					)

74			}

76				continue
77			}
78			notifications = append(notifications, notification)
79		}
80

82			Notifications: notifications,
83		}, nil
84	}

89		if request.Notification == nil {

92	
93		user, notificationID, err := s.resolveUserAndNotificationIDFromName(ctx, request.Notification.Name)

97	
98		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
99		if err != nil {

101		}
102	
103		if currentUser == nil {
104			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
105		}
106		if currentUser.ID != user.ID {
107			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
108		}
109		// Verify ownership before updating
110		inboxes, err := s.Store.ListInboxes(ctx, &store.FindInbox{
111			ID: &notificationID,
112		})
113		if err != nil {
114			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get inbox: %v", err)
115		}
116		if len(inboxes) == 0 {
117			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "notification not found")
118		}
119		inbox := inboxes[0]
120		if inbox.ReceiverID != currentUser.ID {
121			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
122		}
123	
124		// Build update request based on field mask
125		update := &store.UpdateInbox{
126			ID: notificationID,
127		}
128	
129		for _, path := range request.UpdateMask.Paths {
130			switch path {
131			case "status":
132				// Convert API status enum to storage enum
133				var inboxStatus store.InboxStatus
134				switch request.Notification.Status {
135				case v1pb.UserNotification_UNREAD:
136					inboxStatus = store.UNREAD
137				case v1pb.UserNotification_ARCHIVED:
138					inboxStatus = store.ARCHIVED
139				default:
140					return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid status")
141				}
142				update.Status = inboxStatus
143			default:
144				return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid update path: %s", path)
145			}
146		}
147	
148		updatedInbox, err := s.Store.UpdateInbox(ctx, update)
149		if err != nil {
150			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to update inbox: %v", err)
151		}
152	
153		notification, err := s.convertInboxToUserNotification(ctx, updatedInbox, currentUser)
154		if err != nil {
155			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to convert inbox: %v", err)
156		}
157	
158		return notification, nil
159	}

206	func (s *APIV1Service) convertInboxToUserNotification(ctx context.Context, inbox *store.Inbox, viewer *store.User) (*v1pb.UserNotification, error) {
207		usersByID, err := s.listUsersByID(ctx, []int32{inbox.ReceiverID, inbox.SenderID})

218	func collectInboxMemoIDs(inboxes []*store.Inbox) []int32 {
219		memoIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(inboxes)*2)
220		for _, inbox := range inboxes {
221			if inbox == nil || inbox.Message == nil {
222				continue
223			}
224			switch inbox.Message.Type {
225			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT:
226				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoComment()
227				if payload != nil {
228					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
229				}
230			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_MENTION:
231				payload := inbox.Message.GetMemoMention()
232				if payload != nil {
233					memoIDs = append(memoIDs, payload.MemoId, payload.RelatedMemoId)
234				}
235			default:
236				// Ignore notification types without memo references.
237			}
238		}
239		return memoIDs
240	}

242	func (s *APIV1Service) convertInboxToUserNotificationWithUsersAndMemos(inbox *store.Inbox, viewer *store.User, usersByID map[int32]*store.User, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*v1pb.UserNotification, error) {
243		receiver := usersByID[inbox.ReceiverID]
244		if receiver == nil {
245			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "notification receiver not found")
246		}
247		sender := usersByID[inbox.SenderID]
248		if sender == nil {
249			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "notification sender not found")
250		}
251	
252		notification := &v1pb.UserNotification{
253			Name:       fmt.Sprintf("%s/notifications/%d", BuildUserName(receiver.Username), inbox.ID),
254			Sender:     BuildUserName(sender.Username),
255			SenderUser: convertUserFromStore(sender, viewer),
256			CreateTime: timestamppb.New(time.Unix(inbox.CreatedTs, 0)),
257		}
258	
259		// Convert status from storage enum to API enum
260		switch inbox.Status {
261		case store.UNREAD:
262			notification.Status = v1pb.UserNotification_UNREAD
263		case store.ARCHIVED:
264			notification.Status = v1pb.UserNotification_ARCHIVED
265		default:
266			notification.Status = v1pb.UserNotification_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED
267		}
268	
269		// Extract notification type and payload from the inbox message.
270		if inbox.Message != nil {
271			switch inbox.Message.Type {
272			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT:
273				notification.Type = v1pb.UserNotification_MEMO_COMMENT
274				payload, err := s.convertMemoCommentNotificationPayload(viewer, inbox.Message, memosByID)
275				if err != nil {
276					return nil, err
277				}
278				if payload != nil {
279					notification.Payload = &v1pb.UserNotification_MemoComment{
280						MemoComment: payload,
281					}
282				}
283			case storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_MENTION:
284				notification.Type = v1pb.UserNotification_MEMO_MENTION
285				payload, err := s.convertMemoMentionNotificationPayload(viewer, inbox.Message, memosByID)
286				if err != nil {
287					return nil, err
288				}
289				if payload != nil {
290					notification.Payload = &v1pb.UserNotification_MemoMention{
291						MemoMention: payload,
292					}
293				}
294			default:
295				notification.Type = v1pb.UserNotification_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED
296			}
297		}
298	
299		return notification, nil
300	}

330	func (s *APIV1Service) convertMemoCommentNotificationPayload(viewer *store.User, message *storepb.InboxMessage, memosByID map[int32]*store.Memo) (*v1pb.UserNotification_MemoCommentPayload, error) {
331		memoComment := message.GetMemoComment()
332		if message == nil || message.Type != storepb.InboxMessage_MEMO_COMMENT || memoComment == nil {
333			return nil, nil
334		}
335	
336		commentMemo := memosByID[memoComment.MemoId]
337		if !canViewerAccessMemo(viewer, commentMemo) {
338			return nil, nil
339		}
340	
341		relatedMemo := memosByID[memoComment.RelatedMemoId]
342		if !canViewerAccessMemo(viewer, relatedMemo) {
343			return nil, nil
344		}
345	
346		memoSnippet, err := s.memoNotificationSnippet(commentMemo)
347		if err != nil {
348			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get comment memo snippet")
349		}
350		relatedMemoSnippet, err := s.memoNotificationSnippet(relatedMemo)
351		if err != nil {
352			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo snippet")
353		}
354	
355		return &v1pb.UserNotification_MemoCommentPayload{
356			Memo:               fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, commentMemo.UID),
357			RelatedMemo:        fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedMemo.UID),
358			MemoSnippet:        memoSnippet,
359			RelatedMemoSnippet: relatedMemoSnippet,
360		}, nil
361	}

380			Memo:        fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memo.UID),
381			MemoSnippet: memoSnippet,

383		if memoMention.RelatedMemoId != 0 {
384			relatedMemo := memosByID[memoMention.RelatedMemoId]
385			if canViewerAccessMemo(viewer, relatedMemo) {
386				payload.RelatedMemo = fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedMemo.UID)
387				relatedMemoSnippet, err := s.memoNotificationSnippet(relatedMemo)
388				if err != nil {
389					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo snippet")
390				}
391				payload.RelatedMemoSnippet = relatedMemoSnippet
392			}
393		}
394	
395		return payload, nil

89				usersByID[userID] = user

95		for _, userID := range userIDs {

98			}

171	// batchConvertMemoRelations batch-loads relations for a list of memos and returns
172	// a map from memo ID to its converted relations. This avoids N+1 queries when listing memos.
173	func (s *APIV1Service) batchConvertMemoRelations(ctx context.Context, memos []*store.Memo, includeSnippets bool) (map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, error) {
174		if len(memos) == 0 {
175			return map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation{}, nil
176		}
177	
178		currentUser, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
179		if err != nil {
180			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get user")
181		}
182		var memoFilter string
183		if currentUser == nil {
184			memoFilter = `visibility == "PUBLIC"`
185		} else {
186			memoFilter = fmt.Sprintf(`creator_id == %d || visibility in ["PUBLIC", "PROTECTED"]`, currentUser.ID)
187		}
188	
189		memoIDs := make([]int32, len(memos))
190		memoIDSet := make(map[int32]bool, len(memos))
191		for i, m := range memos {
192			memoIDs[i] = m.ID
193			memoIDSet[m.ID] = true
194		}
195	
196		outgoingRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
197			SourceMemoIDList: memoIDs,
198			MemoFilter:       &memoFilter,
199		})
200		if err != nil {
201			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch list outgoing memo relations")
202		}
203		incomingRelations, err := s.Store.ListMemoRelations(ctx, &store.FindMemoRelation{
204			RelatedMemoIDList: memoIDs,
205			MemoFilter:        &memoFilter,
206		})
207		if err != nil {
208			return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch list incoming memo relations")
209		}
210		allRelations := mergeMemoRelations(outgoingRelations, incomingRelations)
211	
212		// Collect all memo IDs referenced in relations that we need to resolve.
213		neededIDs := make(map[int32]bool)
214		for _, r := range allRelations {
215			neededIDs[r.MemoID] = true
216			neededIDs[r.RelatedMemoID] = true
217		}
218	
219		// Build ID→UID map from the memos we already have.
220		memoIDToUID := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
221		memoIDToSnippet := make(map[int32]string, len(memos))
222		for _, m := range memos {
223			memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
224			if includeSnippets {
225				snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
226				if err != nil {
227					return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get memo content snippet")
228				}
229				memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
230			}
231			delete(neededIDs, m.ID)
232		}
233	
234		// Batch fetch any additional memos referenced by relations that we don't already have.
235		if len(neededIDs) > 0 {
236			extraIDs := make([]int32, 0, len(neededIDs))
237			for id := range neededIDs {
238				extraIDs = append(extraIDs, id)
239			}
240			extraFind := &store.FindMemo{IDList: extraIDs, ExcludeContent: !includeSnippets}
241			extraMemos, err := s.Store.ListMemos(ctx, extraFind)
242			if err != nil {
243				return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to batch fetch related memos")
244			}
245			for _, m := range extraMemos {
246				memoIDToUID[m.ID] = m.UID
247				if includeSnippets {
248					snippet, err := s.getMemoContentSnippet(m.Content)
249					if err != nil {
250						return nil, errors.Wrap(err, "failed to get related memo content snippet")
251					}
252					memoIDToSnippet[m.ID] = snippet
253				}
254			}
255		}
256	
257		// Build the result map: memo ID → its relations (both directions).
258		result := make(map[int32][]*v1pb.MemoRelation, len(memos))
259		for _, r := range allRelations {
260			memoUID, ok1 := memoIDToUID[r.MemoID]
261			relatedUID, ok2 := memoIDToUID[r.RelatedMemoID]
262			if !ok1 || !ok2 {
263				continue
264			}
265	
266			relation := &v1pb.MemoRelation{
267				Memo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
268					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, memoUID),
269					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.MemoID],
270				},
271				RelatedMemo: &v1pb.MemoRelation_Memo{
272					Name:    fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", MemoNamePrefix, relatedUID),
273					Snippet: memoIDToSnippet[r.RelatedMemoID],
274				},
275				Type: convertMemoRelationTypeFromStore(r.Type),
276			}
277	
278			// Add to the memo that owns this relation (both directions).
279			if memoIDSet[r.MemoID] {
280				result[r.MemoID] = append(result[r.MemoID], relation)
281			}
282			if memoIDSet[r.RelatedMemoID] {
283				result[r.RelatedMemoID] = append(result[r.RelatedMemoID], relation)
284			}
285		}
286	
287		return result, nil
288	}

299	func mergeMemoRelations(groups ...[]*store.MemoRelation) []*store.MemoRelation {
300		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
301		merged := make([]*store.MemoRelation, 0)
302		for _, relations := range groups {
303			for _, relation := range relations {
304				key := fmt.Sprintf("%d:%d:%s", relation.MemoID, relation.RelatedMemoID, relation.Type)
305				if _, ok := seen[key]; ok {
306					continue
307				}
308				seen[key] = struct{}{}
309				merged = append(merged, relation)
310			}
311		}
312		return merged
313	}

11	func (*APIV1Service) parseMemoOrderBy(orderBy string, memoFind *store.FindMemo) error {
12		if strings.TrimSpace(orderBy) == "" {
13			return errors.New("empty order_by")
14		}
15	
16		// Split by comma to support multiple sort fields per AIP-132.
17		fields := strings.Split(orderBy, ",")
18	
19		// Track if we've seen pinned field.
20		hasPinned := false
21		hasExplicitTimeField := false
22	
23		for _, field := range fields {
24			parts := strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(field))
25			if len(parts) == 0 {
26				continue
27			}
28	
29			fieldName := parts[0]
30			fieldDirection := "desc" // default per AIP-132 (we use desc as default for time fields)
31			if len(parts) > 1 {
32				fieldDirection = strings.ToLower(parts[1])
33				if fieldDirection != "asc" && fieldDirection != "desc" {
34					return errors.Errorf("invalid order direction: %s, must be 'asc' or 'desc'", parts[1])
35				}
36			}
37	
38			switch fieldName {
39			case "pinned":
40				hasPinned = true
41				memoFind.OrderByPinned = true
42				// Note: pinned is always DESC (true first) regardless of direction specified.
43			case "create_time", "name":
44				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
45				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
46					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
47				}
48				hasExplicitTimeField = true
49			case "update_time":
50				// Only set if this is the first time field we encounter.
51				if !hasExplicitTimeField {
52					memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs = true
53					memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = fieldDirection == "asc"
54				}
55				hasExplicitTimeField = true
56			default:
57				return errors.Errorf("unsupported order field: %s, supported fields are: pinned, create_time, update_time, name", fieldName)
58			}
59		}
60	
61		// If only pinned was specified, still need to set a default time ordering.
62		if hasPinned && !memoFind.OrderByUpdatedTs && len(fields) == 1 {
63			memoFind.OrderByTimeAsc = false // default to desc
64		}
65	
66		return nil
67	}

19	// CreateMemoComment creates a comment on an existing memo.
20	func (s *APIV1Service) CreateMemoComment(ctx context.Context, request *v1pb.CreateMemoCommentRequest) (*v1pb.Memo, error) {
21		memoUID, err := ExtractMemoUIDFromName(request.Name)
22		if err != nil {
23			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
24		}
25		relatedMemo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
26		if err != nil {
27			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
28		}
29		if relatedMemo == nil {
30			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "memo not found")
31		}
32	
33		// Check memo visibility before allowing comment.
34		user, err := s.fetchCurrentUser(ctx)
35		if err != nil {
36			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get user")
37		}
38		if user == nil {
39			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unauthenticated, "user not authenticated")
40		}
41		if relatedMemo.Visibility == store.Private && relatedMemo.CreatorID != user.ID && !isSuperUser(user) {
42			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "permission denied")
43		}
44		if request.Comment == nil {
45			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "comment is required")
46		}
47	
48		comment, ok := proto.Clone(request.Comment).(*v1pb.Memo)
49		if !ok {
50			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to clone memo comment")
51		}
52		comment.Visibility = convertVisibilityFromStore(relatedMemo.Visibility)
53	
54		// Create the memo comment first; suppress the generic memo.created SSE event
55		// since CreateMemoComment broadcasts memo.comment.created for the parent instead.
56		memoComment, err := s.CreateMemo(withSuppressMentionNotifications(withSuppressSSE(ctx)), &v1pb.CreateMemoRequest{
57			Memo:   comment,
58			MemoId: request.CommentId,
59		})
60		if err != nil {
61			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo")
62		}
63		memoUID, err = ExtractMemoUIDFromName(memoComment.Name)
64		if err != nil {
65			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.InvalidArgument, "invalid memo name: %v", err)
66		}
67		memo, err := s.Store.GetMemo(ctx, &store.FindMemo{UID: &memoUID})
68		if err != nil {
69			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to get memo")
70		}
71	
72		// Build the relation between the comment memo and the original memo.
73		_, err = s.Store.UpsertMemoRelation(ctx, &store.MemoRelation{
74			MemoID:        memo.ID,
75			RelatedMemoID: relatedMemo.ID,
76			Type:          store.MemoRelationComment,
77		})
78		if err != nil {
79			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to create memo relation")
80		}
81	
82		// The comment memo was converted before the relation above existed, so its
83		// Relations slice is empty. Reload the relations now so that both the API
84		// response and the memo.comment.created webhook payload carry the relation
85		// to the parent memo.
86		relations, err := s.loadMemoRelations(ctx, memo)
87		if err != nil {
88			return nil, status.Errorf(codes.Internal, "failed to load memo relations")
89		}
90		memoComment.Relations = relations
91

23	// SSEEvent represents a change event sent to SSE clients.
24	type SSEEvent struct {

54	// SSEHub manages SSE client connections and broadcasts events.

56	type SSEHub struct {
57		mu      sync.RWMutex
58		clients map[*SSEClient]struct{}
59		closed  bool
60	}

62	// NewSSEHub creates a new SSE hub.
63	func NewSSEHub() *SSEHub {
64		return &SSEHub{
65			clients: make(map[*SSEClient]struct{}),
66		}
67	}

69	// Subscribe registers a new client and returns it.
70	// The caller must call Unsubscribe when done.
71	func (h *SSEHub) Subscribe(userID int32, role store.Role) *SSEClient {
72		c := &SSEClient{
73			// Buffer a few events so a slow client doesn't block broadcasting.
74			events: make(chan []byte, 32),
75			userID: userID,
76			role:   role,
77		}
78		h.mu.Lock()
79		if h.closed {
80			close(c.events)
81		} else {
82			h.clients[c] = struct{}{}
83		}
84		h.mu.Unlock()
85		return c
86	}

88	// Unsubscribe removes a client and closes its channel.
89	func (h *SSEHub) Unsubscribe(c *SSEClient) {
90		h.mu.Lock()
91		if _, ok := h.clients[c]; ok {
92			delete(h.clients, c)
93			close(c.events)
94		}
95		h.mu.Unlock()
96	}

98	// Close disconnects all subscribed SSE clients.
99	func (h *SSEHub) Close() {
100		h.mu.Lock()
101		defer h.mu.Unlock()
102		if h.closed {
103			return
104		}
105		h.closed = true
106		for c := range h.clients {

108			close(c.events)
109		}

112	// Broadcast sends an event to all connected clients.
